notes.md: - **Why India imports coal:** domestic supply of **high-quality, low-ash coking coal** (for steel) is limited; power plants **designed on imported coal** and high-grade coal for **blending** cannot use domestic coal. Coal imports are under **Open General Licence (OGL)** (PIB, Dec 2021).
- **IMF Stand-By Arrangement:** **SDR 1,656 million** for **20 months**, approved by the IMF Board on **31 October 1991**; it supported the 1991-92 and 1992-93 programme.

- **Objectives:** consolidate insolvency laws for **companies, partnership firms and individuals**; resolution in a **time-bound manner** for **maximisation of value of assets**; promote **entrepreneurship and availability of credit**; balance the interests of all stakeholders; set up the **IBBI**.
